messages:
Priya (GlobalBank): Hi all  Procurement wants an air-gapped POC. Constraints: only physical USB delivery or scp from our approved jumpbox, FIPS-only crypto, and an ability to apply urgent patches without reimaging (they call it 'fastpatch'). Need audit trail and offline signature verification. Can Redwood support and how would we package?

Nina (AM): Yes, we can. Proposed: initial full signed bundle via USB, then minibundle deltas for patches. Two signing flows: Redwood-signed or customer-sign (they run signer in their HSM).

Jordan (SE): Minibundle basics: tar.gz with a manifest and a detached signature. Manifest is content-addressed (sha256) and includes base_full_hash, ordered apply steps, and pre/post checksums. Deltas are binary patches for runtime libs and shard diffs for weights.

Maya (Eng): On the runtime side we support three apply modes: hotpatch (no restart), warmpatch (rolling restart), and full replace. Hotpatch only for symbol-only runtime fixes. Model weight changes use warmpatch or full replace.

Sam (Infra): Delivery options: USB stick with labelled bundle id & fingerprint, plus an scp path to our seeded jumpbox cert. Included on media: bundle.tar.gz, manifest.json, manifest.p7s, verify.sh (POSIX), apply.sh, README-apply-checks.md, audit-config.yml. verify.sh will be pure shell using openssl and sha256sum; no internet deps.

Leah (Security): Key constraints: private keys remain in HSM. If customer-signing: we supply unsigned minibundle and a signing helper they run in their environment. Audit: apply.sh must emit an append-only, tamper-evident audit record with bundle id, applied_by, timestamp, and pre/post checksums; local signing of audit entries advised. FIPS mode available; we'll include verification steps. Kernel-level changes may be blocked by host policy.

Jordan (SE): Fastpatch lifecycle: 1) build delta referencing base_full_hash; 2) run internal verify & smoke tests; 3) sign manifest; 4) ship minibundle; 5) customer runs verify.sh and apply.sh; 6) agent writes audit line and optional snapshot creation. We'll include a dry-run flag in apply.sh that validates without changing state.

Priya (GlobalBank): They want an emergency SLA: Redwood produce signed emergency minibundle within 48 hours of request. Can we commit?

Nina (AM): For Redwood-signed artifacts we can commit to 48h generation SLA for the POC, provided we have required inputs: current full bundle hash, allowed patch paths, jumpbox fingerprint, and any HSM signing policy. If customer signs, timeline depends on their ops.

Maya (Eng): Needed from them to hit 48h: base bundle hash, verification cert for jumpbox, list of host paths allowed to be patched, and whether kernel/module patches are allowed. Also acceptance of our rollback snapshot approach.

Sam (Infra): Rolling rollback plan: apply.sh creates a compressed snapshot of changed files (or LVM snapshot) before applying. If post-checks fail, apply.sh will attempt automatic rollback. We'll document manual reinstatement steps if auto-rollback fails.

Leah (Security): Additional mitigations: short-lived signing keys + signed timestamp, offline key pinning, and signed audit batches. We'll draft a minimal POC security checklist: key pinning steps, HSM signing guide, FIPS verification, audit retention expectations, and deny-list of disallowed patch targets.

Jordan (SE): Risk summary: signing key compromise  mitigation = rotation + timestamping; failed patch apply  mitigation = snapshot/rollback; audit gaps  mitigation = locally-signed audit entries and optional later ingestion.

Priya (GlobalBank): One licensing question: do quantized or weight-only deltas require any license re-eval? They want to avoid extra license paperwork for weight diffs.

Nina (AM): For the POC we'll treat minor weight-only deltas as part of the deployed model license; we'll capture formal language in the SOW for production.

Maya (Eng): Recommended POC plan: Day 0 deploy full signed bundle; Day 2 apply a non-critical minibundle to validate delta flow; Day 5 ship an emergency fastpatch (CVE simulation) and verify rollback. Deliverables: signed bundles, verify/apply scripts, runbook, sample audit logs, and offline HSM signing guide.

Sam (Infra): Confirming verify.sh will be POSIX sh and only require openssl + sha256sum. We'll include an optional python verifier for teams that allow it.

Leah (Security): I'll prepare the POC security checklist and HSM guidance.

Nina (AM): Action items: Jordan/Maya produce minibundle spec + sample fastpatch (ETA 2 business days); Sam produce packaging checklist + scripts (ETA 2 business days); Leah draft security checklist (ETA EOD tomorrow); Nina update SOW for POC SLA and license note.

ops-bot: NOTE: include CVE references and mitigation notes in the emergency fastpatch sample.

Priya (GlobalBank): Thanks everyone  will confirm jumpbox details and whether they prefer customer-signed bundles by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:
